# semaphore_ex_global_credential_grant (Resource)

Manages a project grant for a global Semaphore EX credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_global_credential_grant" "application" {
  credential_id = semaphore_ex_global_credential.deployment_token.id
  project_id    = semaphore_ex_project.application.id
  operations    = ["reference", "consume"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (Number)
- `operations` (Set of String)
- `project_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String)
- `status` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `revision` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import semaphore_ex_global_credential_grant.application credential/42/grant/7
```
